reviews.title: Colorfy: Great App, Extremely Frustrating Support
reviews.text:
POS APP……. SO VERY DISAPPOINTED. HOW THIS HAS SUCH GOOD RATINGS IS BEYOND ME. ANAIN POS APP………..  have used Colorfy for years and have spent a significant amount of money on this app because I genuinely enjoy coloring and creating my own artwork. Unfortunately, my experience with Colorfy’s account support has become extremely frustrating.

Approximately 10 months ago, I lost access to my previous Colorfy account after it was banned. I have repeatedly contacted support because I want my old account connected to my current account so I can regain access to the artwork I created over the years. I have provided information about the old account and have repeatedly explained exactly what I am trying to accomplish.

Despite numerous support requests over the past 10 months, the issue remains unresolved.

What makes this particularly frustrating is that the support responses frequently do not address the problem I actually reported. I have received responses about things such as deleting artwork to improve app performance and questions regarding in-game rewards, even though neither of those things was the issue I contacted support about.

I am also currently unable to leave comments on other people’s artwork or comment on my own published artwork. I have reported this as well, but it has not been resolved.

reviews.title: Not Ideal
reviews.text:
Allows you to upload your own images, but with a great deal of struggle. The image is often rejected for no reason, and when I finally found an image it will accept, there’s a wide array of colors, but then I notice the brush is too large to allow me to color in small areas (it acts as a brush even though it’s a color fill bucket, which makes no sense already). I go to tap the other brushes: nope. Gotta subscribe and pay for em. Okay, what about the eraser? Nope. Gotta subscribe and pay for it. 
If you do choose to use a real life image, keep in mind that you will not be able to color it. It will not translate into an outlined image correctly, and the program will blur it so the lines disappear completely.
